definitions.explanation: An attempt to do something difficult or to compete against someone/something.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいことに{挑戦|ちょうせん}する。
{世界|せかい}{記録|きろく}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: I attempted to break the world record.

examples.japanese: これは{大|おお}きな{挑戦|ちょうせん}だ。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜に{挑戦|ちょうせん}する (to challenge ~, to attempt ~)
・{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{受|う}ける (to accept a challenge)
・{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{続|つづ}ける (to continue challenging)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ} (challenger)
・{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき} (challenging, defiant, provocative)
・{再|さい}{挑戦|ちょうせん} (rechallenge, second attempt)

USAGE NOTE:
{挑戦|ちょうせん}する has a positive connotation of taking on a difficult task or pushing one's limits. In loanword form, チャレンジ(する) is also commonly used, especially in casual speech.
